Game Overview

Mini Golf 3D is a golf game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Mini Golf 3D doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Mini Golf 3D?

Mini Golf 3D is a free golf game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Mini Golf 3D free to play?

Yes, Mini Golf 3D is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
